content:
Hi everyone,

I'm Mario Brcic, researcher at University of Zagreb, FER.
I work on AI safety and formal methods, and I've spent the last while formalizing classical impossibility-style results relevant to safety arguments in Lean 4 & Mathlib, reusing what is already available and migrating from other systems and formalizing anew where isn't.

Mostly I'm here to learn from people who know the ecosystem better than I do. The module system in particular has been the steepest part, and I expect I'm still doing things the awkward way. I'll post about the project itself in #general shortly.

Thanks for building all of this, it's grown very powerful. thanks to the fact that Godel II and Gibbard–Satterthwaite are just there to import is why the project was feasible at all.
